undocumented.title: Option 8 clears selection field even when NewEmp program is not invoked (unknown option entered)
undocumented.code_does: Any non-blank value in XSEL — including unrecognised option codes — causes the selection field to be blanked and the subfile record to be updated, even though no action was taken for that option.
undocumented.why_it_matters: Users entering an invalid option code receive no error message; the option is silently discarded and cleared, which may cause confusion.

undocumented.title: TODO comment acknowledges stale design: department pass-through was considered incomplete
undocumented.code_does: A TODO comment in newemp.pgm.sqlrpgle (line 5) states 'need a way to let the parent program pass in a department id', yet the parameter interface already exists and is used.
undocumented.why_it_matters: The stale TODO may mislead maintainers into thinking the department pre-selection feature is unimplemented, when it is in fact fully wired.

undocumented.title: New employee minimum salary enforcement (HR policy floor of 30,000)
undocumented.code_does: The GetError procedure in newemp.pgm.sqlrpgle rejects any salary below 30,000 with the message 'Salary below minimum band'.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This business rule (referenced as a 2015-03 HR policy) is enforced in code but is not described in any specification rule in this cluster.

undocumented.title: Employee ID auto-generation on New Employee screen
undocumented.code_does: On entry to the New Employee screen, getNewEmpId() queries the maximum existing EMPNO, increments it by 100, and pre-fills the employee ID field.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This auto-generation behaviour is not described in any specification rule and could produce unexpected IDs if the max EMPNO is not purely numeric.

undocumented.title: Employee List screen displays total salaries for the department
undocumented.code_does: After loading the employee subfile, the Employees program retrieves the department's total salaries via getDeptDetail() and populates the XTOT field on the screen.
undocumented.why_it_matters: No specification rule describes the display of aggregate salary data on the Employee List screen, making this behaviour unaudited.

undocumented.title: F5 refresh on Employee List screen
undocumented.code_does: Pressing F5 on the Employee List screen calls LoadSubfile() to refresh the employee list from the database.
undocumented.why_it_matters: No specification rule describes this refresh capability for the Employee List screen.

undocumented.title: Employee List screen option 5 displays employee ID via DSPLY (debug stub)
undocumented.code_does: In employees.pgm.sqlrpgle, option 5 on an employee row executes 'DSPLY XID', which is a debug display operation rather than any production screen navigation.
undocumented.why_it_matters: This appears to be an incomplete or debug implementation; no production behaviour is specified or implemented for drilling into a single employee record from the Employee List screen.
